title: Diameter of Binary Tree
summary: Return the largest number of edges on a simple path between two nodes.
statement: Return the largest number of edges on a simple path between two nodes. A path may bend at a shared ancestor, and that ancestor can be below the root. The diameter of a one-node tree is zero.

examples.explanation: The path from 2 to 9 uses three edges.
The full chain has two edges.
There is no edge to count.

hints: Conceptual: A longest path can be split where it changes from going up to going down.
Directional: For every node, compute how far each child subtree extends downward.
Implementation: Combine the two child heights to get the best path through the node. Pass the larger child height plus one to the parent.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time. An iterative postorder with stored heights uses O(n) auxiliary space.
